reason: I get three quotes from crews because I want to compare the numbers myself. A platform that picks the builder for me, when it has not said how it checks anyone, just adds a middleman between me and the people doing the work.
objection: Who checks that the builder is any good? A platform that takes a cut and handles my money has to answer that before I pay anything.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, verifiable record of each builder's past flats and finished jobs, with references I can call, plus escrow that releases money only when I sign off each stage.
